name: R0-GR/LEGO
description: R0-GR, or "Roger," was a B1-series battle droid who served the Freemakers, a human family of scavengers that traveled throughout the galaxy. He was a veteran of the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. He had a mismatched torso and right arm.

data.name: R0-GR
data.birth: Prior to the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.
data.plating: Dark brown torso; light brown head, legs and left arm; white right arm
